[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]200 (Hard Night III) |scale_hp = {{InfoboxContainer|Duo| *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]210 (Easy Night II & III) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]280 (Hard Night II) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]230 (Hard Night III)}} {{InfoboxContainer|Trio| *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]230 (Easy Night II & III) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]330 (Hard Night II) *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]250 (Hard Night III)}} |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Slightly Slow (2) |spawned_by = [[Hex Corpse]] |defense = {{Defense}}25% |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Upper Body''', internally called '''Hex Corpse Upper''', was an enemy that was summoned by the [[Hex Corpse]] upon its death. It was slower than the [[Hex Corpse]], though when playing on the Easy difficulty it had more health than it. In the hard difficulty, their health was identical. It also had 25% defense. ==Appearance== The '''Upper Body''' was the upper half of the [[Hex Corpse]]'s body. It had brown skin with a brown shirt. Its face was covered with multiple, large teeth. ==Strategy== *Early-game towers, like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against this. *The '''Upper Body''' appears alongside the [[Hex Corpse|Lower Body]], effectively making them have double or more health than the [[Hex Corpse]]. **Towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Mortar]] can be useful here. **As the '''Upper Body''' is significantly slower than the [[Hex Corpse|Lower Body]], it is not as big of a threat as [[Hex Corpse|Lower Body]]. *Defense dropping towers can be used to drop its defense. Such towers include the [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]]. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Upper Body''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Upper Body's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Upper Body''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping now drops '''Upper Body's''' defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Upper Body''' removed. {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Hexscape Event]] [[Category:The Nightmare Realm]] [[Category:Containment]]
